name: What Jesus Looked Like
overview: Scripture reveals that Jesus' outward appearance was humble and unremarkable, lacking physical beauty or form that would attract human admiration, as described in Isaiah 53:2. His visage was marred beyond that of any man, causing astonishment (Isaiah 52:14), emphasizing His suffering rather than earthly attractiveness. Prophetic visions, such as those in Ezekiel and Daniel, depict a manlike figure with symbolic attributes like brass appearance, linen clothing, and garments white as snow, reflecting divine purity and authority rather than physical detail. These descriptions focus on His spiritual significance and mission rather than His external form.
